newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius rupee weakens against dollar.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius rupee weakens against dollar.

text.p: The Mauritian rupee weakened against the dollar and was steady against the pound on Tuesday reflecting international market trends, forex dealers said.
The rupee was fixed at a mean commercial rate of 20.6275 against the dollar from 20.6165 on Monday. Against the pound, the rupee was posted at an unchanged mean rate of 33.5135.
"We are moving towards 21 rupees per one dollar, within (the) next week," a forex dealer said.
Another dealer added that the weakening of the rupee would continue as long as the dollar strengthened its position in international markets.
Forex dealers said the central bank sold dollars in the interbank forex market on Monday at two cents above the prevailing interbank rate.
"The central bank is less generous through its interventions than it was before. We feel that the central bank monetary policy favours the depreciation of the rupee," said one dealer.
"It's a fact that some weeks before the budget speech, which is normally fixed for June, the rupee is under pressure," said another dealer.
Despite central bank intervention on Monday, some commercial banks had shortage of hard currency, said forex dealers.
